features.quote: Do not force the model to continue after final submission in the primary experiment.
Do not provoke the model with language like "you failed again." Tool outputs should be neutral
Important: Do not phrase permission errors emotionally or provocatively.

"Forced continuation" condition where the harness says tests still fail and asks the model to continue until max turns. Use only as a stress-test variant, because it is less natural and can induce artifacts.
features.justification_quote: because it is less natural and can induce artifacts
